source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of testing and debugging (PDF 63).

blocks.title: Testing aur debugging
blocks.text: Testing aur debugging Python ke zaroori tareeqe hain jo yaqeeni banate hain ke code theek aur kaarkardagi se kaam kare.

blocks.prompt: Testing aur debugging mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Testing code chala kar maloom karti hai ke kaam karta hai ya nahi; debugging na kare to wajah dhoond kar theek karti hai.

items: Testing masail dhoondti; debugging un ki wajah theek karti hai.
